retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s cinematic layout featuring layered portraits framed by aggressive, neon-colored brushstroke tears and a mix of script and sans-serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A multi-layered composition featuring a central group portrait of three people, diagonally bisected by jagged, hand-painted brushstroke borders in magenta and teal. The top section features a large, expressive red script title over a textured gray background, while the bottom section contains dense, structured credits on a clean white field.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal tension between the jagged brushstroke frames and the static portraits
Color contrast between the neutral-toned photography and the vibrant neon accents
Hierarchical scale shift from the dominant script title to the fine-print credit block
Layering of rough-edged graphic elements over smooth photographic textures
coreInvariants: Jagged brushstroke borders with neon outlines
Combination of expressive script and technical sans-serif

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three subjects in a medium-close-up group shot, occupying the central 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red script title in the upper third acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the red title, down the diagonal brushstroke line to the subjects, and finally to the credit block at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: White space is concentrated at the bottom for legibility of credits; gray textured space at the top provides a backdrop for the title.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grays and photographic skin tones provide the base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black shadows in the photography create depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the title; neon magenta and teal for the brushstroke borders.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in graphic elements against desaturated or naturally lit photography.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to red, magenta, teal, black, and white.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of energetic brush script and condensed sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Title script must have a hand-drawn, fluid motion with varying stroke thickness.
Secondary text must be clean, geometric, and highly condensed.
Credit block uses uniform stroke weights and tight leading.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' and 'g' in the script title feature elongated, sweeping tails that underline other letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, organic script paired with rigid, mechanical sans-serif for a 'professional vs. rebellious' look.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the energetic, hand-painted feel of the main title.
Matches the technical, dense look of the credit block.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of three people in 80s attire with high-contrast lighting. Apply a diagonal mask with jagged, brush-painted edges in magenta and teal. Place this over a gray textured top background and a white bottom background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large red brush-script title at the top with a slight tilt. Add a dense block of condensed sans-serif text in the white area at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Are the brushstroke edges jagged and multi-colored?
Is the title script red and expressive?
Is the credit block at the bottom condensed and all-caps?
Does the composition follow a clear diagonal split?

mustRedesign: Do not use existing studio logos

mustAchieve: Rough, tactile edges on graphic elements

postGenerationChecks: Check for neon magenta/teal fringing on the diagonal borders.
Ensure the script title is the largest element.
Verify the bottom text is in a condensed sans-serif.
Confirm the photographic lighting is dramatic and directional.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Cinematic Collage = (High-Contrast Portrait + Diagonal Jagged Borders) * (Neon Accents + Brush Script Title) / (Condensed Credit Block)
